title: Which source was checked: one change, a diff and an exact SHA
goal: Organize source in EDT/Git with review and reproducible builds without secrets or infobase overwrites.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P11. Preserve accepted work, sources and a DT; distinguish common-module and application roles.

sections.title: Where the question starts
paragraphs: The hint was changed, but the folder contains other uncommitted edits. How do we hand over the exact checked version? Follow one diff line into a new empty infobase and distinguish that from restoring data.

sections.title: Preserve accepted work and choose your own copy
paragraphs: First preserve accepted P11 work, sources and a DT. Run P12 in a separate new file infobase containing only the 12 invented requests. Initially transfer your metadata into a new empty infobase; never load a CF over prior work. Create the 30,45,15,0,60,20,25,35,40,50,55,65 dataset exactly once. If records already exist, do not repeat seed.

Data functions belong to own server common module УчебнаяИтоговая: Server/Server call enabled; Client/Global/Privileged disabled. Приложение.bsl belongs to the separate client application module. Preserve the prior handler and remove only the added call after the experiment. Neither delete nor duplicate old definitions.

sections.title: What Git actually stores
paragraphs: Configuration source describes objects, attributes and handlers. Infobase data consists of particular customers, requests and entered values. Git stores and compares versions of text source; it does not automatically back up every infobase record. This exercise therefore produces two separate items: a source directory for Git and a DT backup containing the accepted infobase state.

Distinguish Designer XML/BSL exports, an EDT project and an infobase containing data. Renaming a directory converts none of these formats. Complete the available Designer/Git route first. EDT is an additional development environment whose compatibility with the installed platform must be checked separately.

sections.title: Complete source of the worked action
paragraphs: In a separate local training Git repository with no remote, caption version 1 became 2. The diff contains only that line. The build uses the exact version-2 commit although version 3 was saved later in the training repository. Therefore the new client shows 2.
Files below belong to their respective modules. Source, loading and observation after running are separate stages.

code.source:
In a separate training XML/BSL folder:
git init --initial-branch=lesson
git add .
git -c user.name="Training author" -c user.email=training@example.invalid commit -m "Saved first training version"
Change only your own caption 1 → 2.
git diff
git add .
git -c user.name="Training author" -c user.email=training@example.invalid commit -m "Updated training caption"
git status --short
git rev-parse HEAD

sections.title: How to read a change
paragraphs: A branch is a separate line of changes in a Git repository. A commit records a set of changes; its SHA identifies that exact commit. The git diff command shows changes since the recorded version. Read those differences before committing instead of treating a successful command as proof of correct behavior.

Change just one hint that belongs to your application. Record where it appears and its original wording. The same workflow should then display the revised wording while objects, customer references and request data remain intact. Unexpected object deletions or replacement UUIDs indicate a different change that needs investigation.

sections.title: Your prediction before running
paragraphs: The working folder contains version 3, but the build came from the saved version-2 SHA. Which caption is expected?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: Version 2. A SHA selects a specific file tree; the current folder is another source. The build records that SHA, the platform version and the new infobase. Its 12 synthetic records were newly created and have different references; they are not restored records from the prior infobase.

sections.title: How to build a verifiable new infobase
paragraphs: A working directory may include edits not recorded in a commit. Run git status --short before testing; empty output means Git sees no uncommitted changes to tracked files or untracked files. Record git rev-parse HEAD and the platform version so another reviewer can identify the source actually tested.

Create a new empty teaching infobase and load the exported configuration files through Designer. Check the configuration, update the database configuration and start Enterprise. Find the changed hint. Source files do not transfer records from the accepted infobase: verify data preservation separately by restoring its DT into another empty infobase. These are separate checks.

sections.title: How state changes
paragraphs: The working folder and chosen commit may differ. Select the version-2 tree, load its XML/BSL into a new empty infobase, then observe the caption. Transferring data would require a separate DT path.

sections.title: When a plausible result is wrong
paragraphs: A fresh build has 12 documents and 440 minutes and is called a restore. Yet document and customer UUIDs differ. Git stores source; a DT is needed for saved data. Another common failure is checking HEAD while leaving a nonempty git status.

sections.title: Handling conflicts and EDT
paragraphs: A conflict means two changes cannot be combined automatically. Preserve both versions, identify the behavior required by each, produce a combined version and rerun both checks. Blindly keeping one side can discard a requirement from the other. First practise this reasoning on a copy of your own text description, retaining the originals.

If EDT is installed, record its version, the platform version and the supported import route; then verify an actual build of your own project. If EDT is absent or compatibility is untested, mark EDT NOT RUN. The observed Designer/Git result remains valid within its own scope.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Save a new independent version-3 caption as a separate commit in your own local training Git. Read the diff: only the message text changes. Record the full new SHA and an empty git status. Build the chosen commit in a new empty infobase and separately state how data was created. Do not report a Designer result as an EDT check.
